## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Quality/Refactoring (types, lints, performance)

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Accessibility audit completed (`npm run test` checks jest-axe)
- [ ] Coverage meets or exceeds 95% threshold (`npm run test:coverage`)
- [ ] E2E tests verified locally (`npm run test:e2e`)

## Security checklist

- [ ] No API keys or credentials committed in the codebase
- [ ] Input sanitization verified for user inputs
- [ ] Zod schema parsing handles invalid payloads safely
